subject: Regional inference variance — acknowledgement and proposed remediation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Regional inference variance — initial acknowledgement

Hi Aditi,

Thanks for flagging the elevated tail latency you observed this morning for your US-West requests. We’ve identified a regionally concentrated increase in P95 and P99 on the hosted inference pool that served some of ClearWave’s traffic between ~07:45 and 09:10 PDT. Our on-call and routing teams activated mitigations and routed affected traffic to an alternate pool; you may see a reduction in errors and tail latency in the next 30–45 minutes.

What we know so far:
- Scope: customers using the shared hosted US-West inference pool (some ClearWave traffic was routed through this pool).
- Symptom: P95/P99 elevation and occasional partial responses (stream truncation) for longer generations (>1k tokens).
- Window observed: ~07:45–09:10 PDT (investigation still ongoing).

Immediate actions taken:
- Traffic rerouted to an alternate pool with different kernel selection profiles.
- Short-lived fallback enabled for long-generation requests to reduce queuing.
- Ops capturing full traces and KV cache metrics for affected requests.

Next steps we’ll follow up with you on:
1) A concise incident summary and timeline once we complete log correlation (by EOD PT today).
2) If ClearWave experienced measurable SLA impact, we will propose a remediation/credit calculation and submit it to our billing team for approval.
3) A technical note with recommended client-level mitigations (batching hints and generation length guards) to reduce exposure to future tail events.

I’ve attached a short impact_summary.pdf with the initial timeline and the logs we can share. Marissa and Sean are looped in and will help finalize the remediation proposal.

Apologies for the disruption — we know latency stability is critical for ClearWave’s live scoring. I’ll follow up by EOD with a clearer picture.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: impact_summary.pdf (summary, 1 page)
From: Aditi Shah <aditi@clearwave.ai>

Cc: ClearWave Support <support@clearwave.ai>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 09:10:46 -0700
Subject: Re: Regional inference variance — initial acknowledgement

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the quick note and the reroute. A couple quick questions from our side:

1) Can you confirm whether requests that hit the degraded window returned partial responses or 5xx errors? We logged a handful of truncated outputs and two 502s, but want to align on what Redwood saw.
2) For billing/credits: our SLA language requires a credit calculation for sustained P95/P99 violations. Can you outline how you’ll calculate impact and timeline for credit application?

We’re preparing an internal incident report as well; if you can provide any raw traces or request ids that would help.

Aditi
Aditi Shah
Head of Platform Engineering, ClearWave
aditi@clearwave.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 07 Jun 2026 10:02:12 -0700
Subject: Internal: proposed credit calc and recommendation

Vanessa/Sean —

I finished the initial correlation of ClearWave’s request IDs against the affected time window. Summary: ClearWave had ~1,120 requests with P95/P99 exposure (longer generations). Of those, 18 returned 5xx/502 errors and ~130 showed truncated streaming segments.

Proposed remediation approach:
- Billing credit: prorated credit for the affected billing units during the window + an additional 5% goodwill credit for operational impact.
- Calculation details in the attached CSV (proposed_credit_calc.csv): includes hourly token counts, estimated cost per-token, and credit amount.
- Timeline: propose to confirm the amount with Billing Monday 8 Jun and issue the credit by Wed 10 Jun, with a formal statement to ClearWave.

Operational recommendations to include in the customer-facing note:
- We will document client-side best-practices for long generations (prefix caching, shorter chunk sizes, prefetch hints).
- Offer an optional one-hour SRE sync to help ClearWave configure the SDK to reduce exposure.

If you want to reduce the timeline we can escalate to Billing today, but that typically adds 24–48 hours to approval.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.csv
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWave — remediation proposal and next steps

Hi Aditi,

Following up with the remediation proposal and the next steps we committed to when we first acknowledged the issue. Thank you for your patience while we correlated traces. Below is a concise package of what we propose.

Incident recap (short):
- Time window: 2026-06-06 07:45–09:10 PDT.
- Symptom: elevated P95/P99 and partial streaming truncation for long generations; small number of 502s.
- Immediate mitigation: traffic rerouted to alternate pool at 08:55 PDT; long-generation fallback enabled.

Remediation (billing and ops):
1) Billing credit: Redwood will apply a prorated credit for the affected billing units for the time window plus a 5% operational goodwill credit. The attached CSV contains the line-item calculation; the total proposed credit is $1,248.70.
2) Timeline: we will submit the approved credit to Billing today (Mon 8 Jun). Credit should appear on your account no later than Wed 10 Jun.
3) Technical follow-up: offer a dedicated SRE consult (1 hour) to review generation length guards and prefetch settings. Please let us know preferred time slots for this week.

Trace and evidence: see the status page incident entry for full trace links and we’ve attached the impact summary and calculation CSVs.

If this plan looks good to you I’ll escalate billing approval and confirm the SRE slot.

Apologies again for the disruption. We value ClearWave’s partnership and want to make this right quickly.

Best,
Vanessa
